data.name: StoneEra
data.detailed_description:
BUILD A COLONY, ONE BLOCK AT A TIME

StoneEra is an isometric voxel colony simulation where you build, manage, and expand a medieval settlement in a fully editable procedural world.

Gather resources, assign villagers to specialized professions, organize production, and reshape the terrain as your small camp grows into a thriving colony. Every block can be mined, placed, or transformed—and every decision leaves a permanent mark on the world.

BUILD AND MANAGE YOUR SETTLEMENT

Start with the essentials, then expand according to the needs of your people. Construct buildings, process raw materials, plan efficient production chains, and decide which projects deserve priority.

Your villagers work as builders, miners, farmers, woodcutters, and other specialists. Assign the right people to the right jobs and keep resources moving as your population grows.

EXPLORE A LIVING PROCEDURAL WORLD

Every new game creates a different voxel landscape filled with forests, mountains, rivers, caves, distinct biomes, and valuable resources.

Day turns into night, weather changes, and the seasons transform the land around your colony. Explore to find fertile farmland, strategic building locations, and the resources your settlement needs to survive and expand.

RESHAPE THE LAND

The world is more than scenery—it is yours to transform. Mine through mountains, dig underground, redirect your expansion around natural obstacles, or rebuild the landscape block by block.

Build with the terrain or redesign it completely. Your colony develops according to your plans, priorities, and creativity.

PLAN, PRODUCE, AND GROW

A successful colony depends on careful resource management. Farming feeds your people, woodcutting supplies construction materials, mining reveals underground resources, and crafting turns raw materials into useful goods.

Balance immediate needs with long-term growth while changing seasons and weather challenge your plans.

KEY FEATURES

  • Build and manage a medieval voxel colony

  • Explore procedurally generated worlds

  • Mine, place, and reshape terrain block by block

  • Manage AI-controlled villagers with specialized professions

  • Organize resource gathering, crafting, and production chains

  • Discover forests, rivers, mountains, caves, and diverse biomes

  • Experience dynamic seasons, weather, and a full day/night cycle

  • Save your colony and continue developing it over time

  • Play at your own pace in a single-player sandbox simulation

LEAVE YOUR MARK ON THE LAND

Every colony tells a different story. Work with the landscape or reshape it entirely, organize your people, and build a settlement that reflects your decisions.

Wishlist StoneEra and follow its development.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6400 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti (2 GB VRAM) / AMD Radeon RX 550 / Intel UHD Graphics 620 (DirectX 11)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11 Big Sur
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i5 (2017 or newer, Metal support)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-compatible GPU
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Core Audio compatible
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 13 Ventura or newer
  • Processor: Apple M1 Pro / M2 or newer
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple integrated GPU (M1 Pro/M2 or newer)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Core Audio compatible
